name: Fluids & pneumatics calculators
about: Offline fluid dynamics and piping: pipe flow and pressure loss (Darcy–Weisbach / Colebrook, fittings), pipe and hose size, pumps, hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders, nozzles and leaks, tank draining, pressure at depth and buoyancy, water hammer, air tanks and compressors.
description: Exact fluids / hydraulics / pneumatics numbers: pipe pressure loss and velocity, pipe or hose size for a flow, pump power and head, hydraulic or pneumatic cylinder force / speed / air use, flow through a hole or nozzle, tank drain time, pressure at depth and buoyancy, water hammer, air tank stored air and run time. Use it whenever an answer needs a number — don't guess.
instructions:
Pick ONE calculator and fill its inputs from the request. Write every value WITH its unit as text ("20 l/min", "25 mm", "6 bar", "30 m"). Leave out what the user didn't say. Fluids: water (default), sea water, air, nitrogen, hydraulic oil ("oil VG46"), diesel, petrol, glycol. Calculators and their inputs:
- pipe_flow: flow (or velocity), diameter (inner), length, material (pvc / pe / copper / steel / galvanized / hose), fittings ("4 elbows, 1 ball valve"), elevation (height it goes up), fluid, temperature
- pipe_size: flow, fluid, line (pressure / suction / return), max_velocity
- pump: flow, head (m) or pressure, efficiency, voltage, fluid
- cylinder: bore, rod, pressure, flow, stroke, force (needed), medium (hydraulic / air), cycles
- orifice: diameter (of the hole / nozzle), pressure, flow, fluid
- tank_drain: tank_diameter (or width + length), hole, height (water level), end_height, inflow
- hydrostatic: depth, width (of a wall), area, volume + mass (buoyancy), fluid
- water_hammer: velocity (or flow + diameter), length, material, closing_time
- air_tank: volume, pressure, consumption, min_pressure, compressor
Example: {"calc": "pipe_flow", "inputs": {"flow": "20 l/min", "diameter": "1/2 in", "length": "30 m", "fittings": "4 elbows", "elevation": "5 m"}}. Answer with the JSON only.
